label: Ten letters, Puig app. XXVI-LII
sample_original: quod revertitur in siciliam alii vero asserunt quod K factus cancellarius debet in catalonia remanere
sample_en: that he is returning to Sicily, while others assert that, [the King of Aragon] having been made chancellor, he must remain in Catalonia
why: Only one page (p. 475, app. XXXV) of the ten letters is in the repository, as a word-by-word Latin check table; Google Books text returned 403. Where signs are seen it builds Latin clauses, but line 4 has several unchecked words and the other nine letters are absent.

sample_original: Aucun fondement que de quelques advis qui leur viennent du lieu ou vous estes, ou sans doute il y a bien de la corruption.
sample_en: No foundation other than a few reports reaching them from where you are, where there is undoubtedly much corruption.
why: Only a two-line excerpt of f132r (lasry_entry.md) with translation; reads as sentences but breaks off ("dig[ne]"); the full decryption is not in the repository.

sample_original: Il n'y a point de doubte que S.A. ne ce sente griefvement offense du refus faict de la levee des deux mil hommes sans congé
sample_en: There is no doubt that His Highness feels deeply offended by the refusal concerning the levy of the two thousand men without leave
why: Three-line excerpt reads cleanly with translation, but only 686/1646 elements are identified and the rest of the letter is not in the repository.

sample_original: vous les fassiez valloir et peser a sa Saincteté y adjoustant de plus la recommandation des grands services de mon cousin le cardinal de Richelieu son frere
sample_en: you should make these qualities count and carry weight with His Holiness, adding the recommendation of the great services of my cousin Cardinal Richelieu, his brother
why: Excerpt of three rows is coherent French with translation; a cancelled passage and truncated end, partly deciphered (93.8%), only the excerpt is available.

sample_original: Che Dal Villeroy et Dal Amb.r Del Re Qui E Con querimonia Che F.P. Communica Con Riformati Di Francia
sample_en: that Villeroy and the king's ambassador here complain that F.P. communicates with the Reformed in France
why: Five-line excerpt builds Italian sentences though with stray capitalisation and an unresolved abbreviation (F.P.); the rest of six pages (254/256 elements) is not in the repository.

sample_original: tempo che io ui dico questo il ? hauendomi riferto l'ho rimandato a Turino per uedere se li e posible di cauarne qualche particolarita
sample_en: the time when I tell you this. The ? having reported it to me, I sent him back to Turin to see whether he could obtain some details
why: Three-line excerpt is readable Italian with one unresolved word; only 87.2% identified overall and the full text is absent.

sample_original: No ay duda que lo de venir con la princesa como dize V. E., siendo con las condiciones que V. E. apunta, seria lo que mejor estuviesse
sample_en: There is no doubt that coming with the princess, as Your Excellency says, on the conditions you specify, would be best
why: Two short excerpts (f72r, f72v) read as clear Spanish with translation, one [?]; only the excerpts are in the repository and only 107 cipher elements exist.

sample_original: Je ne vois que faire pour ce qui est icy une querele particuliere.
sample_en: I do not see what to do about what is a private quarrel here.
why: Single sentence only; it is coherent, but one line of a 12/28-page decipherment is all the repository holds.

sample_original: Don Louis lui escrit et a Fonsaldagne pour les haster d'antr[er] en France et marcher droit a Paris.
sample_en: Don Louis writes to him and to Fonsaldagne to urge them to enter France and march straight to Paris.
why: Postscript excerpt reads well with a doubtful "Mr de Conde?"; the rest of pp. 53-55 is not in the repository.

sample_original: le souverain conseil est de gaigner temps, et que ce seroit assez tost respondre aux ministres de Monsieur de Mantoue quand ilz renouvelleroient leurs instances
sample_en: the wisest course is to gain time, and it would be soon enough to answer Monsieur de Mantua's ministers when they renewed their requests
why: The excerpt is a full, flawless paragraph of French with translation (99.7% identified); only the excerpt is in the repository.

sample_original: Pour avoir droit de se plaindre du duc de Mantoue des graces qu'il depart aux Espagnols, il faudroit l'en rechercher de semblables ou de quipolentes
sample_en: To complain about the Duke of Mantua's favors to the Spaniards, one would have to ask him for similar or equivalent favors
why: Excerpt of f18r reads fluently but is truncated mid-sentence; remainder of the letter (96.5% incl. nulls, some ? values) not in the repository.

sample_original: nous passons le Rhin pour nostre plus grande seurete afin d'avoir se grand fleuve entre les ennemis et nous.
sample_en: We cross the Rhine for our greater safety, in order to have this great river between the enemy and ourselves.
why: Complete three-line passage reads as full sentences with translation; only this excerpt of f127v is present.

sample_original: Ce Seigneur a par deulx fois escript et mande a ceste royne qu'elle laissast passer en silence et dissimulation beaucoup de choses quant au faict de la religion
sample_en: This lord has twice written to this queen that she should let many matters concerning religion pass in silence and dissimulation
why: A complete eight-line paragraph is a clean sentence with translation; but only 2/6 pages are deciphered and just this paragraph is in the repository.

sample_original: Elle achevera sa 22e annee le 25 Octobre prochain, estant nee le mesme mois en mil 692. Elle est bien faite, blonde, le visage rond
sample_en: She will complete her twenty-second year on 25 October next, born the same month in 1692. She is well formed, blonde, with a round face
why: Excerpt from f58v builds coherent sentences with translation (starts mid-phrase); the rest is not in the repository.

sample_original: les Espagnolz luy ont envoye six cens chevaux, parce qu'il avoit (disent ils) peu de cavalerie et luy ont faict demeurer
sample_en: the Spaniards sent him six hundred horsemen because, they say, he had little cavalry, and made him remain there
why: The excerpted cipher paragraph of p107 is complete and fluent with translation; nothing else of the letters is in the repository.

sample_original: Que la moitie de l'argent que Vre Al a ordonne que l'on me donna, ce qui est la seulle cause de ce que je nay pas esté il y a six semaine en chemin
sample_en: the half of the money that Your Highness ordered to be given to me, the sole reason why I did not set out six weeks ago
why: Three-row excerpt reads as a sentence but begins and ends in the middle of a thought; 93.5% visible and the rest of the letter is absent.

sample_original: Il vous suplie de le vouloir informer clairement de vos intentions, soit pour la guerre, ou pour la paix.
sample_en: He begs you to inform him clearly of your intentions, whether for war or for peace.
why: One full sentence, clean; but nine pages only 74.9% visible and in part, and only this line is in the repository.
